name: 3DPower
summary: Polish filament brand (founded 2020 per a retailer) with a wide range: basic, Hyper Speed, HT 150, marble, matte, pastel, dual-colour silk and Select PLA, PETG variants, ABS, ASA, Hyper PA6 and Elasti 90A TPU, including spoolless refills. Company and manufacturer details were not found.

product_lines.name: Basic PLA
product_lines.notes: Tolerance +/-0.03 mm; refills without plastic spool offered.

product_lines.name: Hyper Speed PLA
product_lines.notes: Not to be confused with Raise3D's similarly named product.

additional_notes: Sold via 3dstisk.com and ManoMano; Shumee (a Polish reseller) lists it on mimovrste.com, a reseller link judged too weak to encode as a relationship. No manufacturing relationship found. 3dpower.com returned no content when fetched. SpoolmanDB PR #322 has 15 filaments. Price tier not verified.

provenance.conflicts: Notes rate confidence low-medium. Legal entity not found; whether 3DPower extrudes itself is unknown; 'founded 2020' comes only from a retailer.
